scenes.en: 3 reasons, and what to do instead.
scenes.say: Do you rub your eyes when they feel tired or itchy? Stop! Here are three reasons.

scenes.en: Your hands carry germs that can cause eye infections.
scenes.say: One. Your hands carry germs that can cause eye infections.

scenes.en: Rubbing makes itching and redness worse, not better.
scenes.say: Two. Rubbing makes itching and redness worse, not better.

scenes.en: Hard, frequent rubbing can scratch and weaken the clear front of the eye.
scenes.say: Three. Hard, frequent rubbing can scratch and weaken the cornea, the clear front window of the eye.

scenes.en: Wash your hands, then rinse your eyes with clean water.
scenes.ta: கை கழுவி, சுத்தமான தண்ணீரில் கண்ணை கழுவுங்கள்
scenes.say: Instead, wash your hands, then gently rinse your eyes with clean water. A clean, cool cloth over closed eyes can also soothe them.

scenes.en: Don't use drops on your own. See an eye specialist.
scenes.say: If your eyes itch often, don't use drops on your own. See an eye specialist and get an eye test.
